title: 模式一致性量表：衡量赋予语言模型的信念是否组织其认知
summary: 提出模式一致性量表（SCI），用96道强制选择题、按长度归一化对数似然评分，检验赋予语言模型的信念是否真正组织其行为而非仅改变情绪。在5个1.7B-14B模型、107个条件上验证，信念适配器目标特异性提升17.7分，临床评分者一致率79.5%。
summary_en: Introduces the Schema Coherence Inventory (SCI), 96 forced-choice items scored by length-normalized log-likelihood, to test whether a belief assigned to a language model organizes its behavior rather than merely shifting mood. Validated across 107 conditions on five 1.7B-14B backbones: belief adapters are target-specific (+17.7 points), clinicians recover keyed beliefs at 79.5%, and six published patient simulators fail to carry their core belief better than a one-sentence statement.
